notes.title: small event
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36659708/82fd997262dfb7197bafafb46d03d13572f96d92.png[/img]

hello. long time no see. I'm trying to create a small event.
 
As you know, Easy Pose offers over 1000 different poses. So we're not sure what pose to make anymore. If you don't provide useful data, we may not be able to update the poses any further.

If you write your idea in the comments, 10 people will be entered into a drawing to receive the mobile version DLC or Steam version. The conditions for your comment to be recognized as an idea are as follows:

1. The pose must not yet be provided by Easy Pose.
2. A pose that is difficult for the user to create.
3. Excessive violence, crime, and hentai are prohibited.
4. When posing one model, do not use more than two props.
5. When posing with two models, use only one prop.

We ask for your participation. Thanks for reading.

The event ends on September 15th at 11:59 PM. (GMT+9) Please leave your ideas in the comments on this notice!

P.s. Unfortunately, the development team's health has not yet recovered. As a result, Easy Pose updates have been very irregular, and DLC sales have been dropping.

To solve the problem, we are working with friends who know us well to prepare for game development, publishing, Easy Pose Pose updates, etc.

But what will help us the most right now is for you to purchase Easy Pose and pray for us. We look forward to your continued support. (_ _)

notes.title: Long time no see.... :-)
notes.notes:
Thanks to all of you, we are doing well.

Critical issues in the mobile version of Easy Pose have been fixed, and bug issues in the Steam version of Easy Pose are being improved. We'll try to fix bugs and update new content before summer ends. Our long-term goal is to end Early Access before the end of the year.

Please support us as we reach our long term goal.

thank you.

notes.title: Notice
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36659708/4a81ed00535d15e885e6a2f733a7cd048c94d5ea.png[/img]
hello.

The Easy Pose update is experiencing difficulties due to various issues. We'll explain it to you so you can understand it.

1. Easy Pose Apple version update rejected.

We develop the ios version of Easy Pose, then the Google Play version and then the Steam version in that order. This is because the Apple App Store goes through the most demanding inspection process. And sometimes they ask for new features that didn't exist before. We got two big issues from Apple last summer. They asked us to edit about 1,300 pose thumbnails and then create a membership withdrawal menu. Unfortunately, we don't have a graphics manager due to financial leeway. So we studied Photoshop and replaced the thumbnail image. And we made an membership withdrawal feature and sent it to Apple, but they asked us for an improved version.

2. Developer's disease

A developer on our team is battling depression and ADHD. I am taking medication, but the side effects are so severe that it is difficult to concentrate on my work. He has also recently developed a severe allergy that has prevented him from eating his favorite foods (all alcohol and dairy products). He eats alcohol and dairy and gets sick for several days.

Due to some of these issues, we are having a lot of difficulty in developing Easy Pose. I also suffer from depression, ADHD, and the aftereffects of general anesthesia from surgery.

Many users request that the development of the iOS version of Easy Pose be delayed and that Google Play and Steam versions be prioritized. Unfortunately, there is only one developer of Easy Pose. Therefore, it is difficult to stop the ios version that is already in development.

For the time being, we will do our best to update, while prioritizing the developer's treatment. I am very sorry for not keeping my promise to you.

notes.title: hello. Postponing the update of Easy Pose.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36659708/fcd7df2ccd3c39c146e3deea74b8f9f6c6184359.png[/img]

Notice - About Postponing the Update Schedule.

hello. Postponing the update of Easy Pose.

The mobile version of Easy Pose is the original. So we make the mobile version, then the Steam version.

However, we finished developing the new version about 2 weeks ago, but requested some improvements from the platform side.

1. Add a costume to the model shown in the pose preset icon of Easy Pose.
2. Removed couple poses that could be mistaken for sex poses.
3. Add delete account feature.

Unfortunately, we do not have professional graphic designers on our team. So, after the developer studied the graphics, they modified all about 1300 icons. We are also developing an account deletion function, but it is a complicated task and takes time.

As a result, the update schedule has been delayed beyond mid-September. If the platform rejects the update or requests for feature improvement, it may be delayed. Fortunately, the above improvements are not available in the Steam version.

We are very sorry for the inconvenience.
